small_guidance:
- The double_mish kernel is already memory-bound and tiny relative to conv; further tuning of BLOCK_SIZE/num_warps will not move fast_p meaningfully. If kept, try BLOCK_SIZE=4096 with num_warps=4 and use `tl.sigmoid` based softplus = `x + tl.log(tl.sigmoid(-x))` style or just keep current form — gains <2%.
- Fuse double_mish into the conv epilogue rather than a separate kernel pass to avoid the extra full read/write of the 64×128×254×254 activation tensor.
- Verify tensors are channels_last so the activation kernel coalesces; current contiguous() copy may be redundant after conv.
large_guidance:
- The conv (nn.Conv2d 64→128, 3×3, 64×256×256) dominates the 20.6 ms runtime; baseline cuDNN is 13.8 ms. Replace it with a custom Triton im2col-style GEMM kernel: program tiles over (N, OC_tile, OH*OW_tile), with GEMM-K = IC*kh*kw computed via implicit im2col index math, and fuse bias + double-mish into the epilogue on the accumulator before store.
- Use channels_last (NHWC) layout so the K dimension (IC*kh*kw) loads coalesce; autotune BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N/BLOCK_K over {64,128}/{64,128}/{16,32,64} with num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3}.
- Apply the closed-form mish twice on the fp32 accumulator (`x*tanh(softplus(x))` via `2*sigmoid(2*sp)-1`) entirely in registers; this eliminates two full HBM round-trips of the 128×254×254×64 output tensor.
